explanation: Multiplying by i is a quarter-turn (90 degrees) around the origin in the complex plane, so the powers of i march around a circle: 1 -> i -> -1 -> -i -> back to 1. That is why the powers repeat every 4: i^n only depends on n mod 4. Slide n and watch the green ring jump to the matching axis direction while the orange hand keeps rotating to show the spin between whole powers.
bullets: Multiplying by i rotates a number 90 degrees counterclockwise.
The powers of i repeat with period 4: i^n = i^(n mod 4).
